name: Local Filesystem MCP Server
shortDescription: Secure, scoped read/write access to specified directories on your local filesystem for file operations and workspace editing.
longDescription: Provide LLM agents with strictly sandboxed directory access on your local machine to read files, search directory trees, create/edit source files, and inspect workspace hierarchies.
author: modelcontextprotocol

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read the complete contents of a file from permitted paths.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a new file or overwrite existing file contents.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: Get a detailed listing of all files and folders in a directory.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Recursively search for files matching patterns in allowed paths.

prerequisites: Explicit directory paths to grant access to

installSteps.title: Specify Allowed Directories
installSteps.description: Pass target directory paths as CLI arguments to sandbox file access.

examples.title: Analyze Directory
examples.prompt: List all typescript files in my project and summarize their structure.
